answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 60 POA, released after 30 days. First, the agent posts a trellis of its history — jobs, partners, timestamps. Second, a prism check splits it into facets — timing, counterparties, variety — flagging clones. Clones fail the garden test and forfeit the bond. 100 fakes lock 6,000 POA for 30 POA per epoch, a 200-epoch payback; an honest agent pays 60 once, keeps full rewards.
